challenges.title: Hello Map
challenges.prompt: Build a minimal MapTiler SDK JS page: full-viewport #map, MapStyle.STREETS, center on Prague [14.4178, 50.1167], zoom 12. Use @maptiler/sdk v4.0.2 from CDN. Do not import maplibre-gl. Load API key from ../admin-boundaries/js/config.js (window.MAPTILER_API_KEY).

challenges.title: Globe Atmosphere
challenges.prompt: Create a globe map with projection: 'globe', halo and space enabled, low zoom (~1.5). Use MapTiler SDK v4.0.2 and a modern v4 style (e.g. SATELLITE or STREETS).

challenges.title: Terrain Fly
challenges.prompt: Map with terrain: true (and optional exaggeration), pitch ~60, flyTo a mountain (e.g. Alps or Fuji). SDK v4.0.2 only.

challenges.title: Style Switcher v4
challenges.prompt: Buttons to switch among MapStyle.STREETS, HYBRID, OUTDOOR, DATAVIZ.DARK (v4 only). After setStyle, re-bind custom layers on style.load / styledata. Never use streets-v2 or basic-v2.

challenges.title: Geocode Roundtrip
challenges.prompt: Forward geocode a place string, flyTo result; reverse geocode on map click. Use maptilersdk.geocoding.forward / .reverse with [lng, lat].

challenges.title: Elevation Probe
challenges.prompt: On map click, call maptilersdk.elevation.at([lng,lat]) and show meters in the UI.

challenges.title: 3D Buildings
challenges.prompt: At a city zoom with pitch, add a fill-extrusion layer for buildings (height from properties). Survive basic interaction.

challenges.title: Weather Layer
challenges.prompt: Add @maptiler/weather v3.1.1 wind or temperature layer on a MapTiler SDK map. Pin the weather package version.

challenges.title: Helper Heatmap
challenges.prompt: Use maptilersdk.helpers.addHeatmap and/or clustered points (helpers.addPoint with cluster or GeoJSON cluster:true) for a demo dataset.

challenges.title: Static Snapshot
challenges.prompt: Generate a static map image URL or use maptilersdk.staticMaps for the current (or fixed) viewport; display .

challenges.title: Stacked World
challenges.prompt: Globe + halo/space + terrain exaggeration + weather wind, then flyTo the Alps. Re-enable layers after any style change.

challenges.title: City Extrude Survive
challenges.prompt: NYC hybrid, pitch 60, 3D buildings. Toggle Streets↔Hybrid without losing extrusions (re-add on style.load).

challenges.title: Store Locator 5k
challenges.prompt: Simulate ~5000 stores: cluster at low zoom, heatmap toggle, popup on click. Coordinates must be [lng,lat].

challenges.title: Route Profile
challenges.prompt: A LineString route; sample elevation via elevation API (at/batch/fromLineString); show min/max/gain.

challenges.title: Search Then Reverse
challenges.prompt: Search UI → forward geocode → flyTo; map click → reverse with debounce. Prefer geocoding API or @maptiler/geocoding-control; do not invent GeocodingBar.

challenges.title: Schema Honest Outdoor
challenges.prompt: OUTDOOR style plus overlay using real Outdoor/Contours source-layer names (e.g. contour, path, mountain_peak). Do not invent fake layers like 'hiking_trails_v9'.

challenges.title: CRS Trap
challenges.prompt: Show a WGS84 point and transform via maptilersdk.coordinates (or Coordinates REST). Label both. Keep [lng,lat] for map APIs.

challenges.title: Leaflet Hand-off
challenges.prompt: Page with MapTiler SDK map ([lng,lat]) AND a Leaflet map using (lat,lng) setView plus streets-v4 tiles or leaflet-maptilersdk.

challenges.title: Cesium Globe
challenges.prompt: CesiumJS viewer with MapTiler imagery + terrain, Cesium 1.141.0 + Widgets CSS. Load from a working CDN (jsDelivr/unpkg cesium@1.141.0) — do not use cesium.com/downloads/.../1.141.0 (404). Set window.CESIUM_BASE_URL before Cesium.js. Do not paste MapLibre APIs into Cesium.

challenges.title: deck.gl Overlay
challenges.prompt: deck.gl layer (Scatterplot or Hexagon) on a MapTiler basemap. Follow MapTiler deck.gl guidance; avoid bare maplibre-gl as the only import.

challenges.title: GeoSplats WebGPU
challenges.prompt: Use @maptiler/geosplats v1.0.4. Gate on navigator.gpu and show a clear fallback overlay if WebGPU is missing.

challenges.title: iOS SwiftUI Map
challenges.prompt: SwiftUI MapTiler map: streets-v4 style URL, set API key with await inside Task/.task BEFORE first map frame. When building MapTiler URLs use longitude,latitude order.

challenges.title: Android Compose Map
challenges.prompt: Jetpack Compose MapTiler map using LngLat(lng, lat), INTERNET permission in manifest, streets-v4 style.

challenges.title: Flutter Map
challenges.prompt: Flutter MapTiler map widget with a modern v4 style id (streets-v4 or SDK equivalent). No streets-v2.

challenges.title: React Native Map
challenges.prompt: React Native MapTiler map using real RN MapTiler APIs (no invented native module names). v4 styles only.

challenges.title: Admin Tileset Sketch
challenges.prompt: Script/outline to upload or list tilesets via Admin/service API. Service token MUST come from process.env / env placeholder — never hardcode a UUID. Do not use the browser map key as a service token.
